200.description: Enum lookup tables for the frontend

get.summary: List all profiles visible to the API.
get.description:
Aggregates entries from three locations:
  1. `<data_dir>/working/` — user saves, reported as `source: working`.
  2. `<data_dir>/profiles/` — curated read-only seeds, reported as
     `source: seed`. If a name appears in both `working/` and `profiles/`,
     `working/` shadows `profiles/` (the user's save wins). This mirrors
     `get_profile`'s resolution order so the listing matches what the
     load endpoint will actually return.
  3. `<data_dir>/template/profile.json` — the bundled template entry,
     reported as `source: seed`.

The result is sorted by `last_modified` descending.

200.description: List saved profiles plus the bundled template

post.description:
Always writes to `working/`. Never touches `profiles/` (those are
curated read-only seeds). If a save name collides with a seed, the
resulting working copy shadows the seed in `list_profiles` and
`get_profile`. The frontend is responsible for warning the user
before overwriting an existing working copy.

500.description: Failed to write profile to disk or working dir not mounted

post.summary: Import an xlsx workbook and return the parsed profile as JSON.
post.description:
Accepts a `multipart/form-data` request with a single file field named
`file`. The file must be a valid `.xlsx` workbook. The parsed profile
is returned directly without being saved to disk.

The upload is rejected with 400 when the file exceeds `MAX_XLSX_BYTES`.
Error messages are sanitized: no internal paths or stack traces are
returned to the caller.

400.description: Invalid file, size exceeded, or parse error
Invalid profile JSON or validation errors

get.summary: Resolve and return a profile by name.
get.description:
Resolution order: special `name == "template"` maps to
`<data_dir>/template/profile.json`; otherwise look in `<data_dir>/working/`,
then `<data_dir>/profiles/`, then `<data_dir>/template/{name}.json` as a
legacy fallback. 404 if none match. Working shadows seed so a saved working
copy always wins over the same-named seed.

500.description: Failed to read or parse profile

delete.description:
Only working-directory entries can be deleted. If the name resolves
to `<data_dir>/working/{name}.json`, it is removed. If it would only
resolve to a seed (`<data_dir>/profiles/{name}.json`), the request
is rejected with 400 — seeds are immutable through the API. 404 if
neither location holds the file.

400.description: Invalid profile name or attempt to delete a seed

AiDer.description: AI points belonging to the DER equipment group.

AiInverter.description: AI points belonging to the Inverter equipment group.

AiMeter.description: AI points belonging to the Meter equipment group.

AiPoint.description: An analog input (AI) point defined in the PICS profile. Do not construct it directly; instead, use AiPoint::new.

value.description: The default value of the point, in engineering units.

AiSchedule.description:
AI points belonging to an IEEE 1815.2 Schedule functional group.
The header fields capture the single per-schedule metadata points.
The Vec fields hold one entry per schedule slot, parallel-indexed.
Note: the schedule edit selector is stored in the base AiPoints array, not here.

start_date.description: The number of days since January 1, 1970, UTC.

start_time.description: Delta time in milliseconds from the start date.

stop_date.description: The number of days since January 1, 1970, UTC.

stop_time.description: Delta time in milliseconds from the start date.

AiScheduleBC.description:
AI points belonging to a Backward Compatible Schedule functional group.
The header fields capture the single per-schedule metadata points.
The Vec fields hold one entry per schedule slot, parallel-indexed.
Note: the schedule edit selector is stored in the base AiPoints array, not here.

AnalogInputs.description: All analog input points, grouped by base and functional/equipment type.

points.description: The BASE points; to access *all* points, use all_ai_points_full() or all_ai_points_full_mut().

AnalogOutputs.description: All analog output points, grouped by base and equipment type.

AoBattery.description: AO points belonging to the Battery equipment group.

AoInverter.description: AO points belonging to the Inverter equipment group.

AoMeter.description: AO points belonging to the Meter equipment group.

AoPoint.description: An analog output (AO) point defined in the PICS profile. Do not construct it directly; instead, use AoPoint::new.

BiBattery.description: BI points belonging to the Battery equipment group.

BiDer.description: BI points belonging to the DER equipment group.

BiInverter.description: BI points belonging to the Inverter equipment group.

BiMeter.description: BI points belonging to the Meter equipment group.

BiPoint.description: A binary input (BI) point defined in the PICS profile.

BinaryInputs.description: All binary input points, grouped by base and equipment type.

BinaryOutputs.description: All binary output points in the profile.

BoPoint.description: A binary output (BO) point defined in the PICS profile.

profile.description:
Profile JSON document. The runtime type stays `serde_json::Value`
(preserves the permissive deserialize behavior the existing
frontend relies on); the OpenAPI schema reports the stricter
`PicsProfile` shape via `#[schema(value_type = PicsProfile)]`.

CreateJobResponse.description: Response for POST /jobs: returns only the job_id.

CtrPoint.description: A counter (CTR) point defined in the PICS profile.

EquipmentInfo.description: Per-instance metadata for a single point type within an equipment group.

EquipmentPoints.description: Groups the per-point-type equipment metadata for a single equipment group.

EventClass.description:
DNP3 event class assignment for a point (Class1, Class2, Class3, or None).
Event class represents priority: Class1 > Class2 > Class3.
None means you are not expected to generate events for those points

ExpectedTest.description: A single expected test result within a scenario.

JobStatusResponse.description: Response for GET /jobs/{id}: returns job_id and status.

KeySheet.description: Index and count metadata for all point groups in the profile.

ModeType.description: DER functions in the same order as the "Compatibility of functions" table (58).

PicsProfile.description:
Top-level deserialized representation of a PICS profile document. Unvalidated.
use PicsProfile::new to get Validated<PicsProfile>.

ProfileMutationAck.description:
Acknowledgement payload returned by the mutation endpoints.
Defined here so the schema can be referenced by `#[utoipa::path]` even
though the handlers still return `serde_json::Value` for back-compat.

ProfileSource.description:
Provenance of a profile entry.

`Seed` entries live under `<data_dir>/profiles/` (and the bundled
`template/profile.json`) and are read-only at the deployment layer.
`Working` entries live under `<data_dir>/working/` and are written
by the save endpoint.

profile.description:
Profile JSON data. Accepts both "profile" and "data" field names
for backward compatibility with the existing frontend.

The runtime type stays `serde_json::Value` (preserves the existing
permissive deserialize behavior); the OpenAPI schema reports the
stricter `PicsProfile` shape via `#[schema(value_type = PicsProfile)]`.

Scenario.description: A test scenario with its expected outcomes.

SectionInfo.description: Start index for a single point type within a section.

SectionPoints.description: Groups the per-point-type start indices for a single section.

StopJobResponse.description: Response for DELETE /jobs/{id}: returns a message.
